text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Fine! That reference book on
fairies you
lent me was sooo fun to read!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you enjoyed it! I brought it from
home.
It's a personal favorite of mine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I hope it wasn't too difficult translating it
into
Japanese so you could understand...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It was easy-peasy! It felt like
figuring
out the spells in a
grimoire—really fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Having some dictionaries on hand
certainly
helped, though!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(But so much of the text was in archaic

language... It's astounding she could
decipher it
using only a few
dictionaries.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's like the saying, "What one
likes, one will do
well." Right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. I happen to have some
other
books from home that you might
enjoy, like fairy
tale anthologies and
picture books about witches.
Would you
like to read them?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You bet I would! I'll read anything
you've got if
it's about magic! Are you
sure you don't mind?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's no trouble at all, little Miss
Witch. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! ♪ My witch training's coming
along great
thanks to you!
